pair_note: First post-reanchor pair with non-zero observed predecessor duration. Physical ordering is valid; predecessor active work was observed, not projected.

decision.reason: The valid 28s/679s predecessor pair yielded only 3.96% utilization, so tens-of-seconds voluntary handoffs are strongly dominated while safe useful work remains. Scheduler lead is not changed; only same-wake useful-work duration remains the experimental variable. Continuation was secured before durable-state write.

measurement_guard.rule: work_end_time must be an observed completed-work timestamp at or before the state write; active_work_sec must represent completed useful work only
measurement_guard.purpose: prevent projected durations from being misclassified as runtime-frontier evidence
